responsibility: Translates Fortran constant expressions into backend tree constants and back. It builds integer, real, complex, logical, character, and Hollerith constants; handles string and length objects for character data; initializes shared rank constants; and provides the conversion routines used by other lowering code and by target-memory encoding/decoding.
same_name_distinction: Implements constant lowering and reconstruction logic: building GCC tree constants from Fortran literals, string/character constant construction, MPZ/MPFR conversions, rank constant initialization, and use of target-memory encoding for prescribed representations. The header only declares these conversion/building routines and shared constant nodes.
